status: Read-only director proposal; production specs/music untouched.
recordingPolicy: Preserve current music file/sourceHash/sourceStart/gainDb. Duration changes are tail trims only; pitch/speed and original audio unchanged.
timingPolicy: Differentiate low-frequency body attacks, bright/percussive attacks and mixed-source texture changes. Existing source flux peaks remain candidates, not a beat/phrase authority. Major pose arrival, minor body response and tiny camera impulse have different emphasis. Never quantize all three to every flux peak.
microactionPolicy: One thought-specific continuous internal path per pose window; finite eye lead→head/chest/shoulder/weight response→settle. Feet and held grips remain grounded/rigid. ADB amplitude is typically smaller than Nemi, with2–3frame response offsets where conversation/attention warrants. No procedural universal bounce.
cameraPolicy: Finite base push/pull/pan through the thought plus a small selected source-attack impulse. Maintain focal center, ease continuously where appropriate, avoid hard dead stop before cut. Full-body base scale change≤2% initially; close/detail≤4%; selected impulse0.6–1% with2–4frame arrival/6–10frame release. Recompute real margins; frame-safe art is authoritative, these suggested magnitudes are not guaranteed safe.
